ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota Medicaid Funding
ideas.description: Investigate the potential fraud in Minnesota Medicaid funding and follow the money to see where it leads
questions: Where is the $3.1 billion in Medicaid funding going?
Who is involved in the potential fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. I recommend starting with the Somali transportation companies and following the money to see where it leads.
